name: task-completion
goal: Coding and planning cannot complete without current task and performance evidence

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Require exact-revision task audits and profiling; planning audits validate proposals without implementation

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Loop CLI accepts final free-text claims; measurement coverage permits absent profiles when no budget is declared

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Complete test corpus frozen at 2003b536; immutable red de74c7931382 preserves actual failing CLI and app assertions and pairs with green 0cc99cbae4f1.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared completion audit and Harness profiling reject unsupported CLI, app and agent completion; focused positive and negative proofs pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable green 0cc99cbae4f1 at 3d92ccca pairs with red de74c7931382 at 2003b536; the complete test corpus, command and runtime environment stayed unchanged.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Pending: bun run check reached 907 passing unit tests, two failures; unchanged ownership fingerprints fail at 4eec669c too. The process-settlement case passes alone. Desktop type errors and catalog-reference failures also reproduce before repair. Focused CLI/app proof does not replace full verification.
